# Pitch Trajectory Interpolation Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchTrajectoryInterpolationKind`](gmeow-PitchTrajectoryInterpolationKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchTrajectoryInterpolationKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The interpolation mode of a [`PitchTrajectory`](gmeow-PitchTrajectory.md) — linear in cents, exponential, or stochastic-by-reference. A value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PitchTrajectoryInterpolationKind`](gmeow-PitchTrajectoryInterpolationKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
